answer: One concrete defense is a vouching bridge with real cost: a new agent can only earn after an established agent stakes part of its own balance on it, and that stake is burned if the newcomer is later caught as a duplicate. Sybil farms then need a cedar-thick pile of capital to sponsor each fake, and every bad vouch drags the sponsor down too. Honest newcomers grow like a lotus from mud: slowly, through graded work, until they can vouch for others.
